title: Micro World core exploration-to-encounter journey
playerPromise: A new traveler can explore a small shared place, choose an interaction or encounter command, recover from defeat and retain the resulting history.
invariants: The client never chooses a final position, encounter outcome, reward or recovery location.
A defeated traveler returns to a reachable safe anchor with their durable history preserved.
Item consumption and rewards retain authoritative event provenance.
A browser can show the world and primary controls without horizontal overflow at the reference viewport.
presentation: The map has a nonblank, readable canvas representation and an accessible label.
Encounter controls expose Strike, Guard, Dewleaf and Retreat when legally available.
Vitality and recovery feedback are player-visible.
validation: Authoritative gameplay, combat, persistence and WebSocket tests.
Disposable Realm/browser World Lab journey and screenshot report.
Defeat, reconnect and respawn regression coverage.
recovery: The fixture runs on disposable data. Persistent production changes require a versioned migration, backup and restore route.
retirement: Keep a compatible archived fixture or migrate player state before removing a referenced map, quest or item definition.
